title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: ATEEZ [LIGHT THE WAY] IN CINEMAS
overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished. As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and into the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY.

title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: The End of Oak Street
overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

title: Batwara 1947
overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Compostelle
overview: Fred and Adam have nothing in common. Yet, they will meet while walking the Way of St. James as a form of spiritual path.

title: Make Zhonghe Great Again
overview: After encountering a standout colleague from a company event, Liu Ben, a section chief at Zhonghe Group's branch, embarks on a quirky professional journey with him, uncovering their true self-worth through chaotic workplace challenges.

title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.
